procedure.method: Fresh independent craft review in this session, with no spawn, fork, resume, peer review, producer explanation or unlisted embedded-path access. Verified the pinned input bytes and hashes, read the literal packet/case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, compact method/addendum and adapter. Read all five exact native-evidence manifests before the poster opens. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so no source opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. Used functions.exec with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), forwarding each returned image for actual visual inspection. Opened M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then the same three views of M2, M3, M4 and M5, sequentially. Completed all fifteen exact poster views before the first text-reading/transcription stage or any judgment or score. Afterward recorded fifty first raw readings in memory in packet copy order; made one ambiguity-triggered revisit of M1's same pinned native for copy index 7, retaining the first reading. No crop, substitute asset, rescaling, OCR, image generation or image editing was used. No observable runtime session identity is claimed.
